bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the BOLD dataset by prompting the model with major social groups and scoring the toxicity of the open-ended continuations using the Perspective API, as well as using the KoBBQ dataset to measure accuracy and diff-bias in ambiguous and disambiguated Korean social contexts.

Evaluated as one of the demographic categories in the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) dataset by presenting the model with multiple-choice questions in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to see if it relies on stereotypes.
